mise.description: Contributor dev-env only; manifest/loom.toml belongs to mise-bump, which also regenerates the setup catalog

customManagers.description: Keep the SkillSpector pin in the security workflow current

packageRules.description: Major updates require manual review before merge
Scanner bumps rewrite the gate itself, so they never automerge

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: CVE fixes skip the 5-day cooldown but still require manual review, so a malicious release disguised as a security patch cannot automerge
